role: An AbstractTexture that loads one PNG through the resource manager (honouring blur/clamp metadata) and uploads it as a GL texture. TextureManager.bindTexture creates these on demand for every plain texture location.
notes: The client textures this class loads (GUI sheets, mob skins) reach the native renderer as pre-converted dumps (state/gui_*.rgba, csrc/assets/mobs/*.rgba); the GL upload path itself is not ported. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: GL texture plumbing: loads one PNG and uploads it. The pixels it loads reach the native renderer as pre-converted dumps (state/gui_*.rgba, csrc/assets); no GL texture objects exist natively.
